newsitem.title: CHINA: China marks three minutes mourning for Deng.
newsitem.headline: China marks three minutes mourning for Deng.

text.p: China observed three minutes of official mourning for paramount leader Deng Xiaoping at 10.00 a.m. (0200 GMT) on Tuesday, with 10,000 elite massed in the Great Hall of the People and sirens sounding nationwide.
"Grieve in silence," Premier Li Peng said as the thousands of Communist Party and government leaders stood to attention in the Great Hall, heads bowed.
Funerary music prayed as they bowed their heads before a huge portrait of Deng on the stage in the main hall.

"Eternal Glory to Comrade Deng Xiaoping who enjoys the love and esteem of the peole of the whole party, the whole army and people of all ethnic groups throughout China, read a streamer hanging from one huge balcony.
Streets in Beijing were virtually deserted as Chinese watched the ceremony on state television.
